verdict.rationale: mParticle's first-party docs describe IDSync as its identity resolution framework. It creates a unified view of customers and gives visibility into, and control over, known and anonymous user identities across apps and platforms, which covers the core stitching need. missing for 10: detailed documentation of configurable resolution rules (e.g., identity priorities or merge strategies), explicit cross-device merge mechanics, independent or hands-on corroboration.
